name: A 752-Concept Mixed-Puncture Schedule with One Immobile Wing
definition: Take the archived 294-concept ample class with adjacent marked words 1639 and 1655 and marked coordinate 4, normalize the first endpoint to zero, replace that coordinate by a binary block, and puncture the mixed root-square word 01.
parameters: The two sections have orders 136 and 158, overlap order 65, and union order 229. Their exclusive wings have orders 71 and 93. The block family has 752 concepts in dimension 13.
properties: Both marked endpoints admit complete rooted corner orders. The 71-word wing peels to the overlap, while none of the 93 words in the other wing is initially deletable relative to the overlap. A four-stage schedule of lengths 71, 293, 157, and 228 performs all 749 deletions to the three remaining root-square vertices; an independent outmap check certifies acyclicity and nonclashing.
